contexts.text: As a silver dish contains eatables...

Cleanse first the inside of the cup and of the platter... By the platter is meant the food, and by the food the good of the Word; by the cleansing of the inside of the cup and platter is meant purifying the interiors which are of the will and thought, thus of love and faith, by means of the Word.
On which there were dishes and plates of every kind of food... The dishes and plates were of silver...
Like dirt and eatables in one dish...
Angels send down... a dish containing manna... and this dish is carried round to the guests...
She poured something out of a dish, like a liquor to drink...
By the cup and the platter are signified the interiors and exteriors of man, which receive truth and good; for the cup contains wine, and the platter food... AE 794:3.
